limitations: Baselines are fixed/descending twoSS modeled proxies, not Minstrel or ath10k implementations or measurements.
SNR/PER, diversity gains, burst correlation, preamble/ACK/backoff and traffic are illustrative uncalibrated inputs.
No A-MPDU, BA recovery, TCP dynamics, airMAX TDMA, actual fading waveform, regulatory or peer interoperability validation.
CDD requires an explicit model assumption; chain_mask=3 and STBC=0 do not configure or prove hardware CDD.
Finite enumeration and library ranking validate this model only; no physical RF gain or optimal native schedule follows.

model_assumptions.averaging: equal scenario/seed weights; mean of per-run p99 is NOT pooled p99
model_assumptions.common_random_numbers: separate traffic/channel/outcome/backoff RNG streams shared across policies
model_assumptions.decoder: illustrative logistic success width2dB; twoSS min-chain SNR minus2dB
model_assumptions.delay: p99 of terminal packet sojourn; immediate queue drops contribute0; loss objective retained
model_assumptions.inference: replication SD descriptive only; no confidence or causal hardware claim
model_assumptions.medium: one FIFO SimPy Resource; retries retain reservation; no competing stations
model_assumptions.traffic: 128 finite exponential arrivals; empty initial queue; terminate after all terminal outcomes
